startMessage: SURVIVE - Follow the CACHE marker. At the emergency bag, hold E to search.
recoveryMessage:
CACHE FOUND - Press I for inventory. You start with two hand slots; drag the pouch to BACK to unlock storage.
Take water and one ration. Right-click water, then choose USE.
recoveredMessage:
READY - Hydration restored and one ration carried.
Close inventory and follow the SHELTER marker.
successMessage: SHELTER SECURED - You arrived hydrated with one ration.
failureMessage: SHELTER FAILED - Drink the emergency water and carry one ration before entering. Restarting...
